svg.aria-label: Sentiment Analysis Dashboard: A full-stack web application that analyzes the sentiment of any text input and returns a breakdown of positive, negative, and neutral scores. Built with a Python NLP backend and a React dashboard featuring interactive charts for visual interpretation of results.
